title: Browsers installed during the Docker build are missing at runtime because the user or PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH changed
symptoms: npx playwright install ran as root in the build stage but the app runs as a non-root user
A multi-stage build copies node_modules but not the browser cache
cause: Browsers go to the current user's cache folder unless PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is set, and the runtime looks in the same per-user default. A different user, HOME, or a missing env var at runtime points the lookup at an empty folder.
fix: Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH to one shared folder for both the install step and the runtime, and copy that folder into the final stage. Use 0 to keep browsers inside node_modules instead. The variable does not move branded Chrome or Edge installs.
apply:
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright
RUN npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && chmod -R o+rx /ms-playwright
# final stage
COPY --from=build /ms-playwright /ms-playwright
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright
affected: All Playwright versions in Docker, CI caches and multi-user hosts
